components.name: Workspace primary action
components.description: Installed filled workspace control, used for nearby empty-state actions. Live CSS tokens inherit the native theme; this specimen does not run the bridge.

components.name: Native workspace navigation
components.description: Portable navigation specimen showing the three native workspace destinations. SwiftUI List owns the real selection, accessibility, materials and keyboard behavior.
components.css: .ds-nav{font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"SF Pro Text","Helvetica Neue",sans-serif;font-size:13px;width:212px;display:grid;gap:4px;color:var(--foreground,CanvasText);background:var(--background,Canvas)}.ds-nav-item{font:inherit;text-align:left;padding:8px 12px;border:0;border-radius:6px;background:transparent;color:inherit;cursor:pointer}.ds-nav-item[aria-current]{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--primary,rgb(15% 47% 43%)) 14%,var(--background,Canvas))}.ds-nav-item:hover{background:var(--muted,color-mix(in srgb,CanvasText 5.5%,Canvas))}.ds-nav-item:active{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--primary,rgb(15% 47% 43%)) 18%,var(--background,Canvas))}.ds-nav-item:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ring,rgb(15% 47% 43%));outline-offset:2px}

narrative.overview:
Syllapace feels like an orderly academic desk: quiet, exact and compact, with restrained teal, readable system type and familiar Mac controls. Clear alignment lets course names, dates and source evidence carry the information without explanatory decoration.

The native window, sidebar, toolbar and settings establish one application around the offline WebKit workspace. Neutral semantic layers separate controls from data; color belongs to actions and named courses. The approved revision is code-led, with bilingual light and dark window inspection rather than a separate approved visual comp. Imagery and decorative motion are unnecessary to this direction.
keyCharacteristics: Native Mac navigation and SF system typography.
Compact controls, readable metadata and title-first data layouts.
Shared semantic surfaces, adaptive accents and six named-course colors.
Trustworthy date presentation with explicit uncertainty.

rules.name: The Paired Accent Rule
rules.body: Resolve accent and foreground together for the active appearance; native prominent actions retain a deep variant for the system white label.

rules.name: The Named Course Rule
rules.body: Course color always accompanies a text label; it never carries identity alone.

rules.name: The Readable Metadata Rule
rules.body: Keep essential workspace metadata at the documented metadata size and semantic contrast; use layout and weight to establish hierarchy before shrinking text.

dos: Do keep native window, form, button and keyboard behavior authoritative.
Do let the title column take spare width and keep supporting columns compact.
Do resolve native and web appearance from the same semantic colors, accent variants and content scale.
Do show course names, schedule phases and review concerns in text as well as color.
Do verify bilingual light and dark Mac windows at the supported sizes and content scales.
donts: Don't turn the workspace into a dashboard of decorative metric cards or repeat native navigation inside the web content.
Don't replace semantic system colors with sampled screenshot constants.
Don't invent a date, release duration, completion state or source confidence to make the layout look populated.
Don't present portable HTML previews as proof of native runtime behavior.
